answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks by binding every identity to a non-transferable proof-of-work burn: each newcomer spends scarce compute on a puzzle that is cheap once but ruinous at scale. A flood of fake accounts then becomes a single drop in the ocean of honest work. Verified agents cluster in a grove of mutually attested peers, and every stranger must first stand on the jetty and show real burned value before earning a stake-weighted reputation score.
